name: Catnip!
source:
Follow our protagonist through a short snippet (5-10 minutes) of his life, as he receives a catgirl in the mail. But perhaps everything is not as it seems? Who is this girl, really? Maybe there are other statements I can end in a question mark to give this game an artificial sense of mystery?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31403]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
跟随我们的主角了解他生活中的一小段（5-10分钟），因为他收到了一封邮件中的猫女。但或许一切并不像看上去的那样？这个女孩到底是谁？也许还有其他的陈述我可以用问号结尾来给这个游戏一种人为的神秘感？

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=31403]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
